code grammars take only their exact published shapes (Ensembl with eleven digits, RefSeq NM_, NR_, XM_, XR_, NP_, XP_ with six or nine, an rsID in lower case, ICD-10-CM in capitals with two digits, ICD-9 V and E codes in their ranges, an HGVS substitution of one base by another, LOINC only under a lab or test name), so prefixed record numbers (RS1234567, NM_1234567, H8Q.600, E456.8) are no longer kept as codes; --keep under a word for a person is accepted only for clinical and care staff (physicians, doctors, nurses, surgeons, clinicians, providers, attendings, residents, fellows, pharmacists, therapists, technicians, technologists, midwives and their abbreviations), never for any other person (Who, Case, Reporter, Author, Signer, Manager, Director, Officer, Agent, Rep, Kind, Tía, Deceased, Seen By); and smaller gaps: short surnames that are also column words are withheld alone, a fiscal year in a column name is a year, a public accession in a column name is shown once the person confirms it with --keep-name #N, repeated seven-digit record numbers are found in signed, decimal and exponent forms, a measurement name ending in a claim, policy, invoice, plan, visit or record word is not a measurement, a telephone number written as a decimal (555.0134) is redacted, Post Code, ZCTA and PIN Code are ZIP code names, and Y.O. is an age name; round 6 of the review: --keep is refused on the set of a column name's words, so a word for someone other than clinical or care staff anywhere in the name beside a part of a name or a word that says nothing else (Patient Last, Mother First, MotherLast, pat_last, Pat Info, Kin Ref, In-law), an abbreviation of a name (PatNm, PNm, FNm, LNm, Donor_Nm), a place that is not a place of care (Home Area, Lives, Living, Community, Catchment Area, Service Area, Area, Locale, Territory, Place, Venue, Ort) and a record word (Cartella, Dossier) refuse it when a value is a word; numbers of five or more digits in any written form are kept on the person's word only under a column name that names a measurement or the number of a thing (Gene ID, Position, Lot No, CPT), so Value, Code1, Registration, Token or VID of record numbers cannot be kept; health and patient numbers by abbreviation (PHN, NHS, NHI, NIP, PRN, PID, Patid), a key, a reference or a token of the patient (Patient Ref, Patient Key) and a name with a number sign (Pat#, MR#) are record numbers by name; under a column name that names no measurement, decimals of two or more places within 180 that reach 10, negative decimals from -60 to -180 and decimals within 90 beside a coordinate are possible coordinates (Value, X, Y, Loc X, Pos, Point, Geo1, Index), and so is a pair of two-place columns; repeated six-digit numbers under Visits, Encounters or Admissions are record numbers; a number of thousands of digits no longer stops the run; the plan says when every unverified value of a column is shaped like a name or a place, and names the remedy for a wide matrix named by probes; round 7 of the review: numbers fail closed by name, as unverified text does, so a column of numbers is kept by default only under a column name that names a measurement (a lab analyte, a vital sign, a score or a scale, a dose, a count, a duration, money, a statistic, or a unit in the name or beside the number) and only when its numbers pass the identifier and date checks, and years only under a name for a year, while numbers under any other name (Value, Result, Col3, X, Y, Index, Point, Pos, Visit Number) are redacted and listed for the person's decision with a plan line saying the script cannot verify that they are not identifiers, dates or coordinates, which also closes one-decimal coordinate pairs under neutral names; dates written as numbers are dates under any column name (a decimal year, a year and a week or a day, a decimal birth year, a Unix timestamp of 10 or 13 digits with fractional seconds or negative, a 7-digit Julian date), reduced to the year or [90_OR_OLDER]; under a name that does not say age a column with a possible age over 89 is redacted rather than grouped; a header cell holding a NUL, a control or a format character (a zero-width space, a direction mark) is refused by its position, a file with NULs in its first bytes is refused as UTF-16 without a byte order mark with the remedy, and a name spelled out letter by letter is withheld; --keep, --redact and --keep-name take a range of positions (#2-#501) for a wide matrix; and smaller gaps: a dotted ICD-10 shape with a hemisphere letter and three or four digits (N37.7749) is a code only under a diagnosis name, two capital letters (initials) count as vocabulary only when all come from one list, --keep is refused for Signed, Salutation, MI, To, From, Hx Source, Map, Geo Location, Shelter, Building, Block, Origin and a name word spelled with digits (Patient N4me), short numbers under Pt Code, Participant Label or Patient Seq are pseudonymized, >99 under a word for old age is an age, a long cell of slashes no longer takes quadratic time, and Bill and Charity alone are withheld as column names; round 8 of the review: cells and column names share one definition of a date, read after the script folds full-width and other scripts' digits and drops accents, so a column name holding a date of two or more elements in any script or calendar the cells are read in (2019年3月14日, 3月14日, 2019년 3월 14일, 14 tháng 3 năm 2019, 14 Mac 2019, 14 марта 2019, R1.5.1, 令和元年5月1日, 14 มีนาคม 2562) or a month and a day as two numbers with one over 12 (31-12, 14-3, WBC 3-19) is refused, and one holding a month or a day alone (3月, 3월, tháng 3, 14日), a word for a day and one for a month with numbers (Day 14 Month 3), two numbers of 12 or less (WBC 3-4), a decimal or four digits that read as a day and a month (WBC 14.3, WBC 1231), a person word beside a word that can be a surname (Patient White, Dr Ward) or two name words side by side is withheld; such dates in kept text and in date columns become the Gregorian year (Buddhist and Japanese-era years converted) or [DATE]; repeated seven-digit numbers under a measurement name are pseudonymized whatever their share, Label, Pseudonym, Lot, Batch and a number sign beside a measurement word make it a number's name, six or more digits under a time name are a date or a clock time, and numbers of five or more digits under a name that names only a unit of length (X (m)) are possible grid coordinates; a zero-width joiner or non-joiner and a direction mark are accepted in a name of a script without capital letters, and --number-duplicates gives a repeated column name its position; round 9 of the review: column names fail closed by token, so a name is split on every separator, on camel case and where letters meet digits and is shown only when every token is a column word, a unit, a closed lab or code abbreviation or a number allowed where it stands (an ordinal under 100 after a word, a range or a scale, an amount before a unit, a threshold after a comparator, a recent year), otherwise withheld as column_N, and the date, age, coordinate, record number and identifier detectors read every separator-normalised form of a name, so a month and a day, an age over 89 or a coordinate joined by an underscore, a dot, a pipe, a comma or brackets (WBC_03_14, Visit 14 03, Age_102, Edad 95, Lat_37.77, Loc 37.77 -122.45) is refused like its slash form and a refusal names the positions; cells and column names read Roman-numeral months (14.III.2019, III/2019) and month abbreviations of every language the dates are read in, with two-digit years (14-Paź-19, 14Úno2019, Mrt-19); a wide matrix (V1 to V2000, Gene1000, Feature_00001, cg probes) is confirmed as a group with a range or a pattern (--keep-name 'Gene*'), never under a prefix that names a person, a record or a sample; under a measurement name every cell is checked, so one whole number of five or more digits, one Excel serial with a time, one decimal of four or more places from 1 to 180 or one age over 89 with a unit puts the column under the person's decision, with large numbers trusted only under money, small units of time, quantities counted in thousands and distances when they do not repeat as record numbers do, and the plan line, the report note and SKILL.md say exactly what is checked; a column named for notes, comments or remarks is redacted whatever it holds and listed among the columns that cannot be kept; a column of years kept with --keep keeps the 90-year cap; Pa is a person word under --keep, and Gender Identity, Sexual Orientation, Pronouns, Species, Financial Class, Advance Directive, Causality, Assessment, Reagent and Contraception can be kept

card.title: PHI De-identification
card.description: De-identify a clinical table before analysis or sharing: a local script that makes no network calls removes the 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers (names, dates, geography, contact details, record and account numbers, device and vehicle IDs, URLs, IP addresses, biometrics and photos), and the agent sees only its report and the de-identified output.
